chat.text: A playful jump with a soft landing.

Arms now reach back at 0.20 and pass a forward in-between pose at 0.32 before the V, which removes the take-off snap. Feet are IK-planted from the squat through a new ground take-off key at 0.36, so they no longer sink into the ground. The fall now follows a gravity-like height curve, with offset head and forearm keys and an overshoot-and-settle on the landing.
plan: 0.00–0.24 s: anticipation: sink into a deep squat, torso bends forward, arms swing back early (reach back at 0.20)
0.24–0.36 s: push-off: feet stay planted while the legs extend, arms swing forward through an in-between pose, head lifts
0.36–0.62 s: rise to the apex: arms open into a wide V and overshoot, playful asymmetric knee tuck with a small hip twist
0.62–1.00 s: fall: arms open sideways for balance, legs reach down, eyes on the ground, body accelerates into the landing
1.00–1.22 s: soft landing: compress deep into the knees, arms come forward and down, head counters upward
1.22–1.60 s: recovery: rise with a small overshoot and hip shift, then a little secondary dip
1.60–1.85 s: settle back to the rest pose
